senses.gloss: (b. h.) to be heavy, to feel pain.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 9:3:5">Y. Sabb. IX, 12ᵃ</cite> ib. XIX, 17ᵃ bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 34:25">Gen. XXXIV, 25</cite>) <he>בהיותו כּוֹאֵב כל איבריהם כּוֹאֲבִים עליהם …</he> it does not say, ‘when it (the wound) was painful’, but …, which intimates that all their limbs pained them.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 3:7">Ex. III, 7</cite>) <he>ידעתי … להַכְאִיבֵנִי וכ׳</he> I know how much they will grieve me &c.
<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 12:7">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XII</cite> <he>שלא להַכְאִיבוֹ</he> so as to make him feel no pain.
Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIV (ref. to Prov. III, 12) א״ת וּכְאָב אלא וּכְאֵב … שמַכְאִיבוֹ read not ukh’ab (and like a father) but ukh’eb (and pain), when He sends him pain.
